description: This file defines the React component 'QuickSettingsMenu' which provides a user interface for toggling themes, components, and settings within a web application. It manages state, interacts with application preferences, handles external data streams, and renders menu items with various controls.

methods.name: reloadThemes
methods.description: Loads displayable theme components from the application and updates the themes state, including external features.

methods.name: reloadToggleableComponents
methods.description: Filters and updates the list of toggleable components in the application.

methods.name: toggleComponent
methods.description: Toggles the active state of a given component or theme.

methods.name: deactivateAnyNonLayerableTheme
methods.description: Deactivates the current active theme if it is not layerable.

methods.name: toggleDefaultTheme
methods.description: Sets the application to the default theme by disabling other themes and dark mode.
